label: 底座灯带 · 细条图集
atlasLayout: five horizontal strips stacked vertically; yellow/red/green/blue/white
uvPreparation: offline source UV resampling; runtime consumes saved positions/indices/uvs
stateMapping: review palette only; game status codes not decoded
heightPolicy: existing representative building height; interpolated source mesh Y
compositing: normal premultiplied alpha over existing neutral lamp beauty; no additive doubling

consumerContract.draw: Use indexed triangle Mesh geometry, not a rectangular Sprite. One atlas TextureSource is shared by every palette state.
consumerContract.position: pixelX = spatial.pivotPixels.x + sourceX * pixelsPerCell.x; pixelY = spatial.pivotPixels.y + sourceZ * pixelsPerCell.y; apply the same stage transform as the building.
consumerContract.textureUV: atlasUV = state.uvRect.xy + mesh.uvs * state.uvRect.zw; color is already baked into the atlas, no runtime tint.
consumerContract.heightUV: heightUV = pixelPosition / spatial.framePixels; nearest filtering, no mipmaps, no color conversion.
consumerContract.heightDecode: sceneY = heightMin + (256 * round(R*255) + round(G*255)) / 65535 * (heightMax-heightMin); A=0 means no surface.
consumerContract.occlusion: Interpolate source position Y across each mesh triangle; discard only when height A is valid and lightY + baseElevation + heightOffset + epsilon < sceneY.
consumerContract.blend: Atlas is straight-alpha; shader outputs RGB*alpha and alpha for normal premultiplied-alpha blending.
consumerContract.scope: Fixed top camera; authored static pedestal light; existing representative open_idle building height. Rebuild scene height for neighbor placements; moving occluders require matching pose heights when greater accuracy is needed.

textureProfile.coordinates: logical pixels; physicalRect and image dimensions are physical pixels
textureProfile.dataFilter: nearest packed height/flow coordinates; channel box continuous fields
